label: Красивый / Уродливый
description: Красивый vs уродливый: beautiful/ugly contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Красивый' takes the masculine ending to match 'сад'. The possessive phrase anchors the form in a pleasant everyday scene.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Уродливая' takes the feminine ending to match 'картина'. The spatial detail makes the form concrete.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Красивое' takes the neuter ending to match 'здание'. The sentence stacks two adjectives to show neuter agreement clearly.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Красивые' takes the plural ending to match 'цветы'. The garden image fixes the plural form in mind.

missions.phrase: Красивый дом стоял рядом с уродливым складом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direct masculine contrast. 'Красивый' is nominative for 'дом' while 'уродливым' is instrumental after 'с' for 'складом'. The street scene pairs both adjectives at once.
Strategic focus: Masculine predicate adjective. 'Уродливый' follows the noun as a predicate describing 'свитер'. The casual judgement roots the form in daily life.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental in the predicate. After past-tense 'была', 'красивой' takes the feminine instrumental ending to match 'улыбка'. This shows the быть-plus-instrumental pattern.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental in the predicate. After 'были', 'уродливыми' takes the plural instrumental ending to match 'здания'. The sentence extends the pattern into the plural.
Strategic focus: Short-form masculine predicate. The short form 'красив' states the present quality of 'пейзаж' with an exclamation. Short forms are common in emotive descriptions.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Красивее' is the comparative of 'красивый' and stays the same for any gender. The sentence compares one city to another.
